identity_policy: Each fresh exact HTTPS object matches the read-only cache SHA256; ETag is If-Match identity, not presumed MD5; null versions are mutable

cohort_source.order: Original phenotype CSV row order; all rows retained; source structure/analysis eligibility is a separate contract

acquisition_lineage.cache_equality: Every original response matched the existing read-only cache SHA256; no byte changes
acquisition_lineage.published_sha256: No SHA256 response header was supplied; all listed SHA256 digests are locally measured, not publisher-provided
